_comment: Archived previous field station. Reads the verified unnamespaced legacy API records; never merges them with replacement station measurements.
_projectComment: Must match "project" in the Pi-side config.json. Sent as ?project=... on every API call so this dashboard only shows one project's sensors. Leave empty or omit to view legacy (pre-project) readings.
_sensors_note: Only the sensors listed here are shown, in this order. Use a plain string for defaults, or an object to override name/unit/colour/axis. Set visible:false to keep an entry on file but hide its chart. IMPORTANT: each id must match an id the Pi actually publishes (see the root config.json, and check GET /sensors on the API). A non-empty list here is treated as authoritative and suppresses sensor discovery entirely, so an id with no data behind it draws a permanently empty chart rather than being skipped.

sensors._comment: The MaxBotix MB7389-100 in the standpipe is read over the field Pi's electrically verified /dev/ttyAMA0 on GPIO15/RXD0 and uses GPIO25 for its trigger. A direct test of Sean's reference program repeatedly received the valid R5000 no-target sentinel on ttyAMA0, while /dev/serial0 produced no bytes. Production treats R5000 as zero ponding depth and healthy sensor communication.
sensors.name: Ponding Depth
